# SKML Motion Pictures

SKML Motion Pictures is a premier film production and distribution company based in India, specializing in high-quality Telugu cinema.

## Core Information
- **Founder:** Kandregula Adhinarayana
- **Focus:** Production optimization, global distribution (Theatrical, OTT).
- **OTT Partners:** Amazon Prime Video, Aha.
- **Key Films:** Aghora, Antha Akkade, Hello Baby, Mr. Lonely, Visakha Express.

## Sitemap & Routes
- `/`: Homepage with featured films, producer bio, and company stats.
- `/movies`: Complete filmography (Produced & Distributed).
- `/films/[slug]`: Detailed film page with poster, genre, year, and platform links.

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Next.js (ISR)
- CMS: Professional Content Management System
- Styling: Tailwind CSS / Vanilla CSS
- Analytics: SEO Optimized with JSON-LD and Open Graph.
